name: Mine beetle
description: a beetle the size of a dog from the Ember Wastes: a glossy black carapace with glowing orange cracks, six spiky legs, small mandibles, a swollen glowing orange abdomen full of smouldering eggs

poses.stand: standing on its six legs side-on, the glowing abdomen raised
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands, legs twitching, mandibles clicking, the abdomen pulsing

move.action: scuttles forward on its six legs, abdomen glowing, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: squats and lays a smouldering glowing egg out of its abdomen behind it, then scuttles on

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
